title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager, APAC
description:

title: Partner Account Manager, Japan (Based in Tokyo)
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations
 Tokyo, Japan
 About the Role
 Partner Account Managers, Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations – all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great internet-enabled experiences. title: Software Engineer, Agent Optimization & Evaluation
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are Software Engineers across multiple levels!
The Team
 We're building Reddit's next-generation AI developer platform: a best-in-class agent stack that helps every Snoo build, test, review, and ship software efficiently while preserving Reddit's control over quality, costs, and long-term AI strategy. Our optimization harness measures and improves agents across the software development lifecycle by benchmarking models, detecting regressions, optimizing routing, incorporating production feedback, and improving developer productivity.
 You'll report to Kyle Maxwell and partner with Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and Developer Productivity to shape AI-assisted software development across Reddit.
 The Role
 As a Software Engineer, Agent Optimization & Evaluation , you will lead our agent optimization and evaluation platform. You'll build systems to measure and improve agents' impact on engineering velocity, including Reddit-specific evaluation environments, intelligent model orchestration, and feedback loops that learn from production usage. This hands-on role involves writing production code and building new systems with ownership and autonomy. Strong platform and infrastructure partners will support your work on agent optimization, evaluation, and orchestration.

title: Office Manager, China
description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience. The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
 This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
 This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

title: Responsable commercial B2C & marketing — Voyages à pied et à vélo (H/F)
description:
🌿 D'abord, quelques mots sur nous
 Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.
 Ce sont ceux qui nous invitent à découvrir un territoire autrement, à prendre le temps, à rencontrer ceux qui y vivent et à profiter pleinement de ce que la nature nous offre.
 C'est autour de cette idée que j'ai créé Nature Occitane en 2012.
 Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés qui imagine, conçoit et organise des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités, en liberté ou accompagnés.
 De la Provence à la Catalogne, du canal du Midi aux Cévennes, nous aimons les beaux tracés, les bonnes adresses, les rencontres authentiques et les expériences dont nos voyageurs se souviennent longtemps.
 Nous aimons aussi travailler avec des partenaires locaux, défendre un tourisme plus respectueux des territoires et imaginer des voyages qui donnent envie de partir autrement.
 Nature Occitane a grandi, et nous avons encore beaucoup d'idées pour la suite : de nouvelles destinations, de nouveaux séjours, des voyages bas carbone en Europe et l'envie de devenir une référence du slow tourisme.
 Pour écrire cette prochaine étape, nous recherchons une personne qui aura envie de s'investir pleinement dans notre aventure.
 🚀 Votre fiche de poste 1. Vous serez avant tout sur le terrain commercial. Conseiller nos voyageurs et leur proposer les séjours qui leur correspondent.
 Construire des devis, assurer les relances et concrétiser les réservations.
 Piloter notre activité commerciale avec des indicateurs simples : ventes, taux de transformation, chiffre d'affaires et marges.
 Faire évoluer nos méthodes pour améliorer l'expérience client et notre efficacité.
 2. Vous ferez grandir notre petite équipe commerciale. Accompagner et faire progresser une collaboratrice.
 Organiser les priorités et fluidifier le suivi des demandes.
 Partager vos bonnes pratiques, encourager les initiatives et cultiver l'entraide.…
